correctness.rationale: F_c^*F_c=(2π/c)K_c fixes the normalization; Hellmann–Feynman gives Λ'/Λ=2b/c. Differential ground-state perturbation yields W'(x)=(x²-m)ψ² with W(0)=W(1)=0 and W<0 inside, hence b'<0. Constant trial function yields χ<=q/3 and ψ decreasing, so b<1/2. Then Λ''=(2Λ/c²)(2b²-b+cb')<0 for all c>0. Classical prolate ground-state identification is explicitly invoked.
